sample-contract.content:
SAMPLE PAINTING CUSTOMER AGREEMENT & TERMS

1. AGREEMENT AND DOCUMENTS

The Company paints what the accepted Quote lists.

The agreement consists of:

  1. The accepted Quote;

  2. These terms; and

  3. Any signed Change Orders.

2. PAYMENT TERMS

If the Quote states No Deposit, none is due.

  • A deposit is due on acceptance.

  • The balance is due on completion.

3. ACCEPTANCE

Signing accepts these terms.
